branch-flow: **Branch-flow**: Simplify audit decision tree — Q1 check core scenario defined → Q2 check ≤ 5 inputs and ≤ 1.5 screens → Q3 check concept duplication → Q4 check engineer abstraction. Each branch terminates in pass/flag/block.
state-machine: **State-machine**: idle → audit_requested → auditing → audit_complete \| audit_blocked. Transitions driven by route resolution and capability check results.
decision-priority: **Decision-priority**: Core scenario detection > complexity scoring > duplication check > abstraction detection. Block conditions: missing truth refs, missing DESIGN_ROUTES entry, operator has not defined core scenario.
state-axes: | route_resolution | resolved \| blocked | Whether `beacon design route simplify` resolves. |
| audit_progress | idle \| audit_requested \| auditing \| audit_complete \| audit_blocked | Simplify audit lifecycle. |
| truth_binding | unbound \| bound \| refreeze_pending | Whether accepted simplify findings are truth-bound. |
